title: Which Jujutsu Kaisen character are you? JJK personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Jujutsu Kaisen (JJK) quiz: answer 12 questions to see whether you are Yuji Itadori, Megumi Fushiguro, Nobara Kugisaki, Satoru Gojo, Kento Nanami, Maki Zenin, Toge Inumaki or Aoi Todo. No sign-up.
h1: Which Jujutsu Kaisen character are you?
lede: A kind fighter like Yuji, a careful thinker like Megumi or the strongest, like Gojo? Answer 12 questions and find your match among eight Jujutsu Kaisen sorcerers.
about: Jujutsu Kaisen's sorcerers stand out for their personalities as much as their cursed techniques: Yuji's big heart, Megumi's caution, Nobara's confidence, Gojo's playful arrogance, Nanami's hatred of overtime, Maki's drive to prove herself, Toge's few words and Todo's very specific obsessions.

This quiz scores all eight and shows your match and the runners-up. It avoids story spoilers. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Gege Akutami, Shueisha or MAPPA; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: Who are the main characters in Jujutsu Kaisen?
faq.a: First-years Yuji Itadori, Megumi Fushiguro and Nobara Kugisaki, and their teacher Satoru Gojo. Kento Nanami, Maki Zenin, Toge Inumaki and Aoi Todo are among the most popular sorcerers.

faq.q: Why does Toge Inumaki only say rice ball ingredients?
faq.a: He uses Cursed Speech, so anything he says can become a command. He sticks to rice ball fillings such as "salmon" and "bonito flakes" to talk safely.

items.q: First day at a new school. You…
options: Ask everyone what their type is
Clock out on time. Overtime is the enemy
Do the impossible, then brag about it
Work twice as hard to prove the doubters wrong
You can make people laugh with one word

items.q: Where does your strength come from?
options: Proving I don't need what everyone else was born with
A hammer and a handful of nails
A good book in a quiet café
You put yourself last, every time
You're a bit too aware of how good you are
You won't stop talking about your favorite idol
Say one word and it's over
The people I think deserve it
Whoever the job says, done properly, then I go home
I do it my way, whatever anyone says
A tour of every dessert shop in town

items.q: What kind of leader are you?
options: The teacher everyone looks up to
The reliable grown-up in the room
The quiet one who keeps everyone safe
Complicated. I left to make my own name
Raised by a grandparent whose last words I'll never forget
My best friend is my brother, as far as I'm concerned
"Don't work a minute more than you're paid for"

yuji.name: Yuji Itadori
yuji.body: Kind, brave and incredibly physical. You make friends easily, put others before yourself and try to help everyone you can, just as your grandfather asked.

megumi.name: Megumi Fushiguro
megumi.body: Serious, careful and quietly loyal. You think before you act, choose your battles and keep a few people very close, along with your dogs.

nobara.name: Nobara Kugisaki
nobara.body: Confident, bold and proudly yourself. You moved to the big city to live your way, you speak your mind and you never shrink to fit in.

gojo.name: Satoru Gojo
gojo.body: Playful, brilliant and very sure of yourself. You make the impossible look easy, love sweets and want to raise a stronger generation than the one before.

nanami.name: Kento Nanami
nanami.body: Principled, sarcastic and deeply reliable. You do the job properly, hate overtime and are the grown-up everyone quietly depends on.

maki.name: Maki Zenin
maki.body: Tough, determined and impossible to underestimate twice. You had to prove yourself without what others were born with, and you did it with hard work.

toge.name: Toge Inumaki
toge.body: Kind, loyal and a person of few words. You choose your words carefully because they carry weight, and your friends know exactly how much you care.

todo.name: Aoi Todo
todo.body: Eccentric, intense and a great friend once you're in. You have very strong opinions about your type and your idol, and you'd fight beside your "brother" forever.
